wrong.d: ■wrong 这个单词主要作形容词使用，但也可以当作副词和名词。作为形容词，它有内涵和外延的两方面意义，不应混淆。举个例说，You're wrong. 是从内涵来说你自己本身的判断或做法有错。但You're the wrong man. 则是从外延来说别人有错，把你误作另一个人。 1. 从内涵的意义（即本身有错）使用形容词wrong，往往用作表语。 【 例如 】 The answer is wrong. 答案是错误的。/ The time given in the newspaper was wrong. 报上登载的时间是错误的。/ I thought it was silver, but I was wrong. 我以为那是白银，但是我错了。/ You were wrong in your suspicions. 你怀疑错了。/ I was wrong to assume that he would help me. 我还以为他会帮助我，结果错了。 用作放在名词之前的定语时，如果仍然是从内涵角度说明其本身有错，要在wrong前面加不定冠词a（复数无冠词）。 【 例如 】 The doctor ordered a series of tests to prevent a wrong diagnosis. 大夫嘱咐做一系列的检查，以避免误诊。/ He made a number of wrong assumptions. 他做出了若干错误的推断（但是更多是以the代替a，见下）。 2. 从外延的意义（即被他人从多个个体中错误地选出）使用形容词wrong，必须放在名词（不能用代词）之前，而且前面更为常用定冠词the而较少用不定冠词a。这个the的使用，不完全符合逻辑，但是，如果“误中“的行为已经发生，其对象已经从外延角度确定为仅仅一个，那么，就这一点来说，用定冠词表示“唯一”也有符合逻辑之处。 【 例如 】 You have come to the wrong (少用a wrong) place. 你来错了地方。/ It's the wrong (少用a wrong) time of year for cherries. 现在不是樱桃上市的季节。/ One of those executed was clearly the wrong (不用a wrong) man.被处决的人当中有一个显然是冤枉的。/ The wrong (少用a wrong) man was arrested. 抓错了人（顺便说一下，著名电影导演Alfred Hitchcock在1956年曾经导演过一部片子，讲一个人蒙冤被诬告的故事，片名就叫做 The Wrong Man）。/ Miers is the wrong (少用a wrong) choice for the wrong (少用a wrong) reason. 米尔斯是出于错误的原因提出的错误人选。/ They are the wrong (不能说They are wrong) people for the job. 找他们来干这个工作是找错了人。/ The clock shows the wrong (少用a wrong) time. 时钟上的时间不对。/ Too late he began to realize that he had set up in the wrong neighborhood. (E. Phillips Oppenheim, The Illustrious Prince, Chapter XXV, Hobson's Choice) 他太晚才觉察到自己创业的街区选择错了。 然而，即使“误中”的行为属于将来，尚未发生，其对象尚未确定，英语也习惯在wrong前面加上定冠词the。 【 例如 】 I'm afraid I'll make the wrong (少用a wrong) decision. 我担心自己会作出错误的决定。/ They could not afford to make the wrong (少用a wrong) choice. 他们如果做出错误的选择，后果是吃不消的。/ What if the cipher code falls into the wrong (不说falls into wrong) hands? 万一密码误落他人之手怎么办？ 3. 内涵和外延并不是互不相干的，而是互相影响的。比如说，“误诊”固然是诊断的内容（内涵）本身有错，但也可以理解为医生从若干可能的诊断当中选中了一个其实病人没有害的病，错误判断，说是他害了，这就可以说是这个诊断在外延意义上被错误选中了。因此，说医生作出了 a wrong diagnosis或是 the wrong dia …

wrongful.d: ■wrongful 这个形容词，意义同wrong有些区别，主要是指法律或组织措施上的“冤枉”或“不当”。 【 例如 】 wrongful dismissal不当解雇 / wrongful arrest错捕 / wrongful conviction错误定罪 / wrongful execution错误处决。也可以指“不正当”、“非法”。 【 例如 】 wrongful concealment of assets非法隐瞒资产。

yes.d: ■Yes, I do. 在教堂举行婚礼时，神父或牧师照例要分别问新郎和新娘：Do you take ×× as your lawful wife/husband, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better or for worse, for richer or for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and cherish until death do you part? 你是否娶／嫁给某某为你的合法妻子／丈夫，从今天起，与她／他厮守终生，无论是祸是福，或穷或富，或病或健，都相亲相爱，直到死亡将你们分开？此时新郎新娘的标准回答是：Yes, I do. 因此，Yes, I do. 成了举行婚礼的一句必用语，也成了婚礼的标志，to say "Yes, I do." 就等于“举行婚礼”。

you.d: ■you 1. 古英语第二人称代词有单复数之分，单数（“你”）是thou，复数（“你们”）是ye。在现代英语，已经不分单复数，一律用you。但是为了避免歧义，往往说“你们”时，后面加上个复数名词。例如：you guys男女通用；you gentlemen专用于男性，较有礼貌；you ladies专用于女性，较有礼貌；you folks或you people男女通用；you kids专用于儿童；you two你们俩。美国南方常用you all（读音y'all）表示“你们”，带有亲切的口气。这个you all甚至有它的主有形容词you all's(=your)。 【 例如 】 What are you all's plans for Christmas? 你们过圣诞节有什么计划吗？ 在特殊的场合，甚至可以用一些别的词语来明确you所指。例如在一个警察破门逮捕罪犯团伙的场面，警察对几个不同的嫌疑犯发出命令说： You by the wall !... Don't start anything! Just turn around and face that wall! You other two —join him, do the same.” 靠墙边的那个！…不许动！转过身，脸对着墙！你们另外两个，也同他一样。 2. 打电话时一开始互相通报是谁，不能单刀直入地称“你”“我”。中文可以问：“您是哪一位？”但英文不能问：*Who are you? 要问：Who is that ? （美国英语可以以this代替that: Who is this? 或Who's there?）接电话要转告时问对方是谁，可以说：May I say who is calling? 熟人通电话时，问对方是不是某人， 不能说Are you...? 在英国要说：Hello, is that ... ? 在美国要说Hello, is this ... ?互相通报完毕之后，就可以“恢复正常”，用you, I, me了（参见this条）。 3. 中文以及许多其他语言，在第二人称的称呼上，出于礼貌考虑，比较讲究，也比较复杂。英文则自从以复数的you取代了单数的thou之后，就几乎让you一统了天下，倾向于简单处理。什么“你”、“您”、“君”、“阁下”、“台端”、“先生” 、“钧座”、“我公”、“明公”、“贵将军”、“使君”、“兄”、“仁兄”、“吾兄”、“足下”，甚至“殿下”、“陛下”，往往都可以用you一带而过（至少不必一再重复Your Honour, Your Excellency, Your Highness, Your Majesty等）。 【 例如 】 First, Your Majesty, thanks for coming. It's great to have you back... I look forward to discussing with you a wide range of issues of our—of mutual concern. And I look forward to your wise counsel and advise. (George W. Bush, Welcoming King Abdullah of Jordan, Dec. 4, 2003) 首先，感谢陛下光临。欣逢陛下再到此地，十分高兴…我期待着同陛下一起商讨范围广泛的共同关心的事项。我等待倾听陛下睿智的意见和指教（you在中文不能译成“您”，更不能译成“你”，只好一直译成“陛下”）。/ "Half a century has done nothing to diminish the respect and affection this country holds for you. We receive you again today in that same spirit,"Cheney told the queen (= Queen Elizabeth II of Great Britain, visiting the US) in a welcoming speech. (The Associated Press, May 4, 2007) （美国副总统）切尼在欢迎辞中对女王说：“尽管过了半个世纪，我国对陛下的敬爱丝毫未减。今天我们又抱着同样的心情迎接陛下。” 但是，直接用第二人称，有时候还是有点令人觉得不大妥当。因此，许多别的语文，都借用第三人称来表示。中文和日文也都与此类似，常常避免直接说“你”或“您”。英文则如上所述，不那么禁忌。但有时下级对上级也使用第三人称的名词来代替you。 【 例如 】 If the captain is (= If you …

your.d: ■your 有时候your可以不是“你发出的”而是“你收到的”。 【 例如 】 How to store your letters. 如何存放你（收到的）信件。/ Wait for your instructions in the mail. 请等候用邮政给你发出指示。/ Listen carefully to your instructions. 用心听着给你的指示。（参见my orders条）。

zero.d: ■zero 与一般的理解不同，zero后面名词如果是可数的，一定要用复数，如果是不可数的才可以用单数。 【 例如 】 The company has zero assets and zero liabilities. 公司既无资产也无负债。/ Zero degrees Centigrade is the same as 32 degrees Fahrenheit.摄氏零度等于华氏三十二度（但是“在零度”也有说at zero degree的）。 / We are likely to see zero growth on the stock market this year. 今年股市很可能是零成长。/ You'll get zero help from him. 你不会得到他任何帮助的。

(for insurance purposes) 将(受损被保财产)交承保人申请全额赔付 idiom ◆ to abandon (all) hope 放弃希望；不再抱希望 On the weekend, rescuers abandoned all hope of finding him alive. 时至周末, 救援人员对活着找到他已不抱任何希望。 ◆ to abandon ship 弃船 The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship. 军官和水兵们准备弃船。 ◆ to abandon yourself to sth <文> + feelings 陷入, 沉湎于(某种情感) We were afraid to abandon ourselves to our feelings. 我们不敢放纵自己的情感。 abandon² /əˈbændən/ n. with abandon 放任；放纵 They were smoking and drinking with abandon. 他们肆意抽烟、喝酒。 The surplus food was consumed with joyous abandon. 剩余的食物被大家尽情地吃掉了。

(means of entry; to place, room) 通道；入口；入径；使用途径 'Single garage with side access for a boat or caravan' “带侧面入口的独立车库, 船只、房车可进” The only access was a circular iron staircase. 唯一的入口是钢制旋转梯。 access to sth 通往…的途径 These measures are intended to ease traffic congestion and improve access to the port. 这些措施旨在缓解交通拥堵, 使到港口的路更好走。 The Mortimer Hotel offers easy access to central London. 从莫蒂默酒店可方便地到达伦敦市中心。 to give access to sth 通往… The door gives access to a living room. 穿过这扇门可以进入一间客厅。 to gain access 可以获得；可以进去 Scientists have only recently been able to gain access to the area. 直到最近科学家才得以进入这一地区。 The burglars gained access through a window. 窃贼是通过窗户进入的。 wheelchair access 轮椅通道 4. affirmative action.d: affirmative action n. <美> (positive discrimination) (抵制在就业、教育等方面歧视少数族群和妇女的)平权行动, 反歧视行动 Culture Note affirmative action 在美国，通常用affirmative action（平权行动）来表示招工就业中对少数族群和妇女等弱势群体的优待政策。这项政策始于肯尼迪总统主政的20世纪60年代，当时第一次为少数族群设立了配额，保证他们获得更多的工作机会和大学入学资格。1972年通过了《平等就业机会法案》（Equal Employment Opportunities Act),随后成立了平等就业机会委员会（Equal Employment Opportunity Commission,EEOC)来执行这些保障措施。但是，围绕这项政策产生了很多争议。平权行动在多数族群（比如白人或男性)中间引起了不满，他们认为该政策导致了新的歧视，就是针对多数族群的所谓逆向歧视（reverse discrimination)或善意歧视（positive discrimination)。此后，严格的配额规定有了一定程度的放松。 英国有关平等就业和教育机会方面的法律规定，任何人都不得以性别或种族的原因歧视别人，否则就是违法行为。2007年成立了平等与人权委员会（Equality and Human Rights Commission,EHRC),确保上述权利受到保护。 → see also culture note in Equality and Human Rights Commission

( alights , alighting , alighted alit ) <正式> 1. passenger + (从交通工具上)下来 Passengers travelling to Edinburgh should alight at the next station. 前往爱丁堡的乘客应该在下一站下车。 to alight from sth 从…下来 Three men alighted from the plane. 三个男人从飞机上下来。 Alighting from the taxi, she paid off the driver. 她从出租车上下来, 把钱付给司机。 2. bird + 飞落；降落 It flew across to the tree and alighted on a branch. 它向对面的那棵树飞去, 落在树枝上。 Phrasal Verb alight on

align.d: align /əˈlaɪn/ vt. 1. (line things up) 使成直线；使对齐 He positioned the two chairs so that they were perfectly aligned. 他把两把椅子完全对齐排好。 Keep the rough edge of the fabric aligned with the raw edge of the piping. 把布料的毛边和滚边的毛边对齐。 the stars are aligned for sth… 万事俱备 The stars are all aligned for the IOC to give the Olympic Games to Canada. 天时地利人和, 下一步就等着国际奥林匹克委员会把奥运会的举办权交给加拿大了。 2. (bring into correct position) + components 校正；调准； + parts of the body 调整 It can damage your tyres if the wheels are not properly aligned. 如果车轮没有校正, 会对轮胎造成损害。 Use a tripod to align and steady the camera. 用三脚架调准和稳定相机。 3. 【政】 使结盟 to align sb against sb 与某人结盟反对某人 He called for a war against the forces aligned against his country. 他号召向那些联合起来对抗他的国家的军事力量开战。 to align sb with sb/sth 使某人与…结盟；使某人支持… Lehmann said he was proud to be aligned with the campaign. 莱曼说他为支持这个运动感到自豪。 There are signs that the prime minister is aligning himself with the liberals. 有迹象表明首相正在与自由党人结盟。 4. (coordinate) + interests, operations, goals 使一致；使协调 The interests of the two companies were more closely aligned five years ago. 这两家公司的利益五年前更为息息相关。 There are times in the economic cycle when supply and demand are not aligned. 在经济周期中有时供求关系不协调。 to be aligned with sth 与某事物协调(或一致) Your career goals are quite closely aligned with your current role. 你的职业目标与你现在的职位相当一致。 5. to align yourself with sb or to be aligned with sb 【心】 与某人相一致；认同某人 The therapist was clearly aligned with the parents during this exploratory session. 在这次探查性的治疗过程中, 治疗师显然对家长表示支持。

alignment.d: alignment /əˈlaɪnmənt/ n. 1. (in a straight line) 成一直线；直线排列 the alignment of mirrors in the telescope 望远镜中镜片的直线排列 an exact alignment of Earth, Moon and Sun 地球、月球和太阳的三点一线 2. (in the correct position) +of components, wheels 校正；调准； +of body parts 调整 Check that the car wheels are in correct alignment. 查看一下汽车轮子是否校正了。 The exercises are aimed at improving postural alignment. 这些练习旨在促进体态的调整。 3. (line formed) 直线 The north-south alignment of the house provides shade during the hottest part of the day. 房屋的南北走向在一天中最热的时候也能提供阴凉。 4. 【政】 (affiliation) 结盟；联合 The church should have no political alignment. 教会不应涉足政治。 alignment with sb/sth 与…的结盟 His increasing alignment with the Reagan administration nearly cost him re-election. 与里根政府日益紧密的关系差点让他失去了连任的机会。 5. +of practices, interests, goals 协调；一致 to bring sb/sth into alignment (with sb/sth) 使某人/某事物(与某人/某事物)协调一致 Further consultation is needed to explore whether it is possible to bring the two groups into alignment. 需要进一步磋商, 以探讨是否有可能使这两个团体相互配合。 It was an opportunity to bring Georgia's electoral process into closer alignment with European standards. 这是个使格鲁吉亚的选举进程更符合欧洲标准的机会。 See also nonalignment 6. 【建】 (铁路、公路等的)平面图 7. 【考古】 石排 8. in alignment 位置正确的 Your shoulder, hip and knee should all be in alignment. 肩膀、髋部和膝盖三者的位置要正确。 in alignment (with sb/sth) (与某人/某物)协调一致的 We talked about our goals and we're in alignment. 经讨论, 我们的目标是一致的。 Our party's principles are, we believe, in alignment with the values of the American public. 我们相信, 我们党的原则与美国公众的价值观是一致的。 9. out of alignment (not in straight line) 不成直线的 Our teacher doesn't like it when the desks get out of alignment. 我们老师不喜欢课桌排得不整齐。 (not in correct position) muscles, bones, teeth, wheels, headlights + 位置不正确的 High heels throw the body out of alignment. 高跟鞋让身体错位。 out of alignment (with sth) (与某事物)不协调的 Prices for beef and cattle appear to be out of alignment. 牛肉和牛的价格似乎不协调。 The country's interest rates are out of alignment with the rest of the world. 该国的利率与世界其他国家不协调。

all at once.d: 1. just the once 只有一次 2. all at once (suddenly) 突然；忽然 All at once there was someone knocking on the door. 忽然有人敲门。 (simultaneously) 同时；一起 3. at once (immediately) 立即；马上 I knew at once that something was wrong. 我立刻意识到情况不妙。 (simultaneously) 同时 They all arrived at once. 他们都是同时到达的。 Everybody is talking at once. 所有人都同时在说话。 <文> (both) 既…(又…) It was at once a question and a command. 这既是询问, 也是命令。 4. for once (exceptionally) 仅此一次；破例一次 She was able, for once, to relax. 只有这一次, 她能够放松一下。 See once

all by herself.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)她自己 Laura introduced herself. 劳拉做了自我介绍。 She's hurt herself. 她伤了自己。 Barbara stared at herself in the mirror. 芭芭拉盯着镜子中的自己。 She poured herself a cup of tea. 她给自己倒了一杯茶。 2. (for emphasis;in person) 她亲自 (alone, unaided) 她独自；她一个人 (as opposed to others) 她自己；她本人 Sally herself answered the door. 萨莉自己去应了门。 Kirsty had made the jam herself. 柯丝蒂自己做的果酱。 Laura herself died soon after. 不久之后劳拉本人就去世了。 3. (her normal self) (用在连系动词后)她正常的状态 She's not herself today. 她今天感觉很不舒服。 4. (referring to things personified as female) (用于指被比拟成女性的事物, 惯指船和国家)她 Britain's dream of herself began to fade. 英国自己的梦想开始褪色。 5. <苏格兰,爱尔兰> (woman of the house) 主妇；女主人 Is herself at home? 女主人在家吗？ 6. by herself or all by herself (alone) 她单独地；她独自地 She doesn't like travelling by herself. 她不喜欢独自旅行。 Is she all by herself? 她是独自一人吗？ (unaided) 她独立地；靠她自己地 She managed to unblock the sink by herself. 她自己设法疏通了水槽。 See herself

all by himself.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)他自己 Peter introduced himself. 彼得介绍了自己。 He's hurt himself. 他伤了自己。 He talked mainly about himself. 他主要谈了自己的情况。 He was talking to himself. 他在自言自语。 2. (for emphasis;in person) 他亲自；他本人 (alone, unaided) 他独自；他一个人 (as opposed to others) 他自己；他本人 John himself answered the door. 约翰自己去应了门。 Brian had written it himself. 这是布莱恩亲笔所写。 Brown himself died soon after. 不久之后布朗本人就死了。 He himself was not a keen gardener. 他本人不是个很热衷于园艺的人。 3. (his normal self) (用在连系动词后)他的正常状态, 他平时的样子 Jamie's just not feeling himself. 杰米感觉很不舒服。 4. <过时> (standing for 'himself or herself') (在英语书面语中, 用于指未指明性别的人)他自己, 她自己 The child's natural way of expressing himself is through play. 玩耍是孩子自然表达自我的一种方式。 5. <苏格兰,爱尔兰> (man of the house) 男主人 How is himself? 男主人好吗？ 6. by himself or all by himself (alone) 他单独地；他独自地 He was travelling by himself. 他在独自旅行。 Is he by himself? 他是独自一人吗？ (unaided) 他独立地；靠他自己地 Terry once built a house all by himself. 特里曾独自一人建了一所房子。 See himself

all by itself.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)它自己 Britain must bring itself up to date. 英国必须使自己与时俱进。 What strange new trials the human race invents for itself. 人类给自己新添了多少古怪的磨难啊。 The museum has bought itself a submarine. 博物馆自购了一艘潜艇。 2. (emphasizing a noun) 它自身；它本身 The work itself is not difficult. 工作本身并不难。 I think life itself is a learning process. 我认为生活本身就是一个学习的过程。 The involvement of the foreign ministers was itself a sign of progress. 外交部长的介入本身就是取得进展的一个标志。 3. (emphasizing a quality) (用于强调某种品质)极度, 非常 She is kindness itself. 她善良至极。 Many men are charm itself. 很多男人十分有魅力。 4. (its normal self) (用在连系动词后, 指动物或生物机体)它正常的状态 My cat isn't itself today. 我的猫今天很反常。 5. by itself or all by itself (alone) 单独地；独自地 Treatment is with melatonin, by itself or in combination with bright light. 使用褪黑激素进行治疗, 可单独使用或与强光配合使用。 (unaided) 独立地；自动地 The flame will go out by itself. 火自己会熄灭。 (apart) 单独地 There was another photo, by itself on the big desk under the window. 还有一张照片, 孤零零地摆放在窗户下面的大桌子上。 See itself

all by myself.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)我自己 I've hurt myself. 我伤了自己。 I really enjoyed myself. 我玩得非常开心。 when I look at myself in the mirror 当我看着镜子里的自己 I don't like talking about myself. 我不喜欢谈论自己。 I felt ashamed of myself. 我为自己感到羞愧。 I told myself not to panic. 我告诉自己不要惊慌。 2. (for emphasis;in person) 我亲自；我本人 (alone, unaided) 我独自；我一个人 (as opposed to others) 我自己 I am too busy to come myself. 我太忙了, 来不了。 I made it myself. 我自己做的。 I couldn't have put it better myself. 我已经做到最好了。 I myself like writing poetry. 我本人喜欢写诗。 3. (being polite) (代替me或I作动词或介词宾语, 用于强调或表示礼貌)我(自己) He was roughly the same age as myself. 他大概和我同岁。 I don't think either Steve or myself were playing well today. 我认为我和史蒂夫今天表现得都不太好。 4. (my normal self) (用在连系动词后)我正常的状态 I'm not feeling myself today. 我今天感觉很不舒服。 5. by myself or all by myself (alone) 我单独地；我独自地 I don't like travelling by myself. 我不喜欢独自旅行。 (unaided) 我独立地；靠我自己 I did it all by myself. 我独立完成了。 See myself

all by oneself.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)自己 There can be a great temptation to talk oneself out of good moves through uncertainty. 人在举棋不定时很容易说服自己放弃有益的行动。 To work one must have time to oneself. 一个人要工作就必须有属于自己的时间。 He seemed to believe one could buy oneself a clear conscience. 他似乎认为用钱就可以求得心安。 2. (without help from others) (用于强调)独自, 一个人 It's quicker to do it oneself. 这件事自己去做会快一些。 3. <正式> (people in general) (用作动词或介词宾语)自己, 自身 It's so easy to feel sorry for oneself. 人很容易为自己感到遗憾。 4. <正式> (your usual self) (用在连系动词后)正常的状态 One doesn't feel oneself after such an experience. 人们在经历那样一件事情之后会感觉不自在。 5. by oneself or all by oneself (alone) 单独地；独自地 Watching television by oneself is a very enjoyable way to pass the time. 一个人看电视是消磨时间的好办法。 (unaided) 独立地；靠自己地 See oneself

all by ourselves.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)我们自己 We really enjoyed ourselves. 我们玩得非常高兴。 We almost made ourselves ill. 我们都快把自己弄病了。 We made fools of ourselves. 我们出丑了。 We really were feeling sorry for ourselves. 我们为自己感到非常遗憾。 My husband and I decided to buy ourselves a dog. 我和丈夫决定给自己买条狗。 2. (for emphasis;in person) 我们亲自；我们本人 (alone, unaided) 我们独自 (as opposed to others) 我们自己；我们本人 We always go ourselves so we know what we're buying. 我们总是自己去, 所以我们知道要买什么。 We built our garage ourselves. 我们自己建了车库。 With the exception of ourselves, everyone spoke Spanish. 除了我们, 每个人都说西班牙语。 3. (our normal selves) (用在连系动词后)我们正常的状态 We are ourselves when we're together. 我们在一起时才感觉自在。 4. (in combination with other people) (在复合名词短语中代替we或us)我们 We would urge anyone with information to contact the police or ourselves. 我们会督促任何知情人士联系警方或我们。 The kids and ourselves were playing and running around. 孩子们和我们在一起玩耍奔跑。 5. by ourselves or all by ourselves (alone) 我们单独地；我们独自地 (unaided) 我们独力地；靠我们自己地 We did it all by ourselves. 我们靠自己完成了。 See ourselves

all by themselves.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)他们自己, 她们自己, 它们自己 They all seemed to be enjoying themselves. 他们好像都玩得很开心。 Did they hurt themselves? 他们伤着自己了吗？ people who talk constantly about themselves 总是谈论自己的那些人 I think they sorted it out between themselves. 我想他们自己已经把问题解决了。 They've given themselves a difficult task. 他们给自己找了件难办的事。 2. (for emphasis;in person) 他们(或她们、它们)本人 (alone, unaided) 他们(或她们、它们)自己 (as opposed to others) 他们(或她们、它们)本身 clients who were too elderly to come themselves 年纪太大、不能亲自过来的顾客 They must settle it themselves. 他们必须自己解决这件事。 Let's turn to the books themselves. 让我们回到书本身吧。 3. (himself or herself) (尤用于代指前文所提及的one、whoever或anybody)他(或她)自己, 他(或她)本人 Anyone who believes this should be ashamed of themselves. 谁要是相信了这件事, 那他就应该替自己感到羞愧。 Nobody was prepared to commit themselves. 谁也不愿意让自己牵涉其中。 Each student makes only one item themselves. 每个学生自己都只做一件。 4. (their usual selves) (用在连系动词后)他们(或她们、它们)正常的状态 5. by themselves or all by themselves (alone) 单独地；独自地 All the guests had left, and they were by themselves. 所有的客人都走了, 只剩下他们自己。 (unaided) 独立地；靠自己地 They built their house by themselves. 他们自己建造了房子。 See themselves

all by yourself.d: all by yourself 完全一个人 I did it all by myself. 全是我自己做的。 See by

all by yourselves.d: 1. (used reflexively) (反身代词, 可作直接宾语、间接宾语或介词宾语)你们自己 Did you enjoy yourselves? 你们自己玩得开心吗？ Be honest with yourselves. 诚实地面对你们自己。 Buy yourselves something nice. 你们给自己买点好东西吧。 2. (for emphasis;in person) (用于强调亲自)你们自己 (alone, unaided) (用于强调独自)你们自己 (as opposed to others) (用于强调不是其他人)你们自己 Even if you don't go yourselves, please help me get volunteers. 即使你们自己不去, 也请帮我找些志愿者。 Did you make it yourselves? 这是你们自己做的吗？ Do you yourselves know why she came? 你们自己知道她为什么来吗？ 3. (being polite) (代替you作动词或介词宾语, 用于强调或表示礼貌)你们(自己) How are yourselves? 你们过得怎么样？ 4. by yourselves or all by yourselves (alone) 你们单独地；你们独自地 You can rent the island for a week and enjoy the great beach all by yourselves. 你们可以租岛一周, 独享美妙的海滩。 (unaided) 你们独立地；靠你们自己 And to think you did that all by yourselves with no help from us. 想想那是你们独立完成的, 丝毫没有我们的帮助。 See yourselves

(signal) 警报解除信号；险情解除信号 The all clear was sounded ten minutes after the alert was given. 警报发出10分钟后响起了险情解除信号。 Listen for the all clear before each transfer. 每次转移前注意听警报解除信号。 2. (permission) 准许；许可；障碍清除信号；问题解决信号 to give sb the all clear 给予某人许可；向某人表明已无障碍(或问题) I was given the all clear by the doctor to resume playing. 医生准许我恢复比赛。 to get the all clear 得到许可；收到障碍已清除(或问题已解决)的信号 As soon as we've got the all clear, I'll order the trucks. 一旦我们得到许可, 我就叫那些卡车来。 You're not allowed to travel on a plane until you get the all clear from the doctor. 只有得到医生的许可你才能坐飞机。

(loyalty to group or movement) (对团体、领导者、运动等的)拥护, 拥戴 This is a community driven by strong ties and allegiances. 这是一个紧密团结、精诚合作的团体。 allegiance to sb/sth 对…的拥护(或拥戴) You owe absolute allegiance to him. 你应该绝对拥护他。 My allegiance to Kendall and the company was strong. 我对肯德尔和公司高度忠诚。 to switch your allegiance or to switch allegiance 改变拥护(或拥戴)对象 In Sale, disappointed voters switched their allegiance in droves. 在塞尔, 一批批失望的选民改变了他们的拥戴对象。 2. <正式> (loyalty to sovereign) (对统治者或国家的)效忠, 忠诚 to swear allegiance to sb/sth or to pledge allegiance to sb/sth 宣誓效忠… They swear allegiance to the Crown. 他们宣誓效忠国王。 their refusal to pledge allegiance to the Queen 他们对向女王宣誓效忠的拒绝 a pledge of allegiance 效忠的誓言 New citizens swear a pledge of allegiance to the Queen. 新公民宣誓效忠女王。 3. 【史】 (封建社会中封臣对领主或君主的)臣服义务 Both knights owed allegiance to Bishop Odo and were granted lands in Kent under his protection and patronage. 两名骑士都向奥多主教表示臣服, 在他的庇护和恩赐下获得了位于肯特的土地。

american civil war.d: American Civil War /əˈmerɪkən ˈsɪv ə l wɔː/ n. the American Civil War 【史】 (1861至1865年间的)美国南北战争, 美国内战 Culture Note American Civil War 美国人通常把美国内战（American Civil War)简称为内战（Civil War）。美国内战发生于1861至1865年，在北方和南方之间展开，因此也叫南北战争。北方的联邦州（Union states)由亚伯拉罕·林肯（Abraham Lincoln)领导，主张国家统一。南方的邦联州（Confederate states)由杰斐逊·戴维斯（Jefferson Davis)率领，要求从联邦（Union)独立出去。奴隶问题是美国内战的核心问题之一。1860年林肯当选总统是触发内战的导火索，因为林肯希望废除奴隶制，而南方则要求保留奴隶制。美国内战共造成超过60万人死亡，很多人系因缺医少药失去生命。战争使南方的土地和房屋受到巨大破坏，北方也受到战乱影响。1865年4月，南部邦联投降，美国内战结束，美利坚合众国保持了统一。 → see also culture note in Memorial Day

american dream.d: American Dream n. the American Dream 美国梦 Culture Note American Dream 美国梦（American Dream)通常指在美国的社会、经济和政治制度下人人都有可能成功的观念。很多美国人会用这个词来描述美利坚民族的生活状态和追求目标。美国梦代表了美国人心目中的积极价值观和原则，而这些价值观和原则也是1776年《独立宣言》（Declaration of In-dependence)所确立的。它强调个人主义、努力工作、人人享有晋升和改善的机会以及自由和公正的价值观。许多移民把美国梦作为碰运气和出人头地的一个途径。但这个词有时用作反语，提醒人们注意上述理想与美国当代社会中很多人奉行的物质主义态度之间存在着的巨大反差。

[=he approved the plan] 他赞成这项计划。 Presumably he was acting with the government's blessing . 他大概是在政府的授意下行事的。 They got married without their parents' blessing . 他们没有征得父母同意就结婚了。 b : help and approval from God 上帝的恩宠；神赐 We asked the Lord's blessing on us and on our project. 我们祈求上帝赐福给我们以及我们的计划。 2 [ count ] : something that helps you or brings happiness 幸事；福气 — usually singular 通常用单数 My daughter is a blessing to me in my old age. 上了年纪有我女儿真是我的福气。 E-mail can be a blessing if you travel a lot in business. 如果你经常出差，那么电子邮件真能帮你大忙。 It's a blessing that you came when you did. 你那时候来真是幸运。 ◊ Something that is a blessing in disguise seems to be a bad thing at first but actually is a good thing. 祸中得福（看似坏事实际最终使人得福之事） Not getting the job turned out to be a blessing in disguise , since she got a much better job soon afterward. 没得到那份工作其实是塞翁失马，因为之后不久，她就找到了一份比那好得多的工作。 ◊ If something is a blessing and a curse or a mixed blessing there are both good and bad things about it. 好坏参半之事；利弊各半之事 Being famous can be a blessing and a curse . 出名是件让人喜忧参半的事情。 The promotion was really a mixed blessing because I'm now so busy that I don't have time to spend the extra income. 那次升职真是有利有弊，现在我忙得都没时间去花那些多挣的钱。 3 [ count ] : a short prayer （简短的）祷告 He said a blessing before the meal. 他饭前做了祷告。 4 [ noncount ] : the act of asking God to care for and protect someone or something 祈祷；祈求上帝赐福；祈神保佑 The priest performed the blessing of the fishing boats. 牧师祈求上帝保佑那些渔船。 count your blessings : to make a special effort to appreciate the good things in your life 细数幸福；珍惜幸福 I try to remember to count my blessings every day. 我尽量每天都细数自己所拥有的幸福。
